name: ai-token-alternatives
title: AI Token Alternatives
description: An AI answer marks words the model was unsure about with a dotted underline. Clicking one opens a small panel of the other words it considered, each with a probability bar; choosing one rewrites the reply from that word on.
use: An AI answer should show where it was uncertain and let the reader swap a word without retyping the prompt.
avoid: It is built as a chat card with a prompt bubble and footer, and needs a compose function to regenerate after a pick.
a11y: Word buttons carry probability labels, the listbox handles arrow keys and Escape, and a live region announces updates. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A chat card on dark: a grey user bubble at top right, then the reply in body text where some words carry a dotted underline. The floating panel lists options in a column, each with a thin orange or grey bar and a percentage.
behaves: The answer streams in word by word with a blinking cursor. Clicking a dotted word opens a panel with the current word ticked; picking another swaps it, re-streams the rest and leaves a small edit chip in the footer. A Confidence switch tints words by uncertainty.
customise: Pass a prompt, slot options with probabilities and a compose function that rebuilds the answer; className is the only style hook. The chat layout and demo copy live in the source.
weight: light: Plain text tokens, one small panel and short springs; the typing timer stops once the answer is out.

props.name: compose
props.type: (choice: Record<string, string>, signal: AbortSignal) => ComposedAnswer | Promise<ComposedAnswer>
